The Planner prematurely concluded that the task was complete with the wrong year (1960), likely because it misinterpreted 1960, the year Francisco José Hernández arrived in Miami as mentioned in the search results, with the actual year of the invasion. This reflects a reasoning failure, where the Planner did not synthesize the timeline from retrieved information properly, instead focusing on an earlier year mentioned in passing.
